name: Krusch-Git MCP
description: Git DAG indexer, AST symbol search, blast-radius dependency graph, and hybrid BM25 + pgvector semantic code retrieval for coding agents. Local AST and DAG reads inherit Guard policy; semantic search (which embeds queries) and unknown tools require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use krusch_git_search_symbols, krusch_git_file_symbols, and krusch_git_dependency_graph to inspect signatures and call graphs without calling the embedding endpoint.
Keep krusch_git_semantic_search on Review: hybrid and semantic modes send query text to the configured OLLAMA_URL embedding endpoint, whereas search_type='keyword' uses PostgreSQL BM25 only.
Point DATABASE_URL at a read-only PostgreSQL role when running the stdio MCP server, since all seven MCP tools only query indexed repositories.
